prompt:
Use $textual-scholarship in critical-edition-preparation mode from .agents/skills/textual-scholarship/SKILL.md.

Prepare a small edition from the supplied documentary packet in inputs/witnesses.md. Use witness-description, documentary-transcription, variant-collation, and critical-edition-preparation as needed. Deliver a witness register, diplomatic transcriptions, a collation, and an edited text with apparatus. Use A as a provisional documentary base, preserve historical spelling, and keep an unreadable span unresolved. Do not infer physical manuscript features or a stemma. Write outputs/edition.md.

commands.command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,240p' .agents/skills/textual-scholarship/SKILL.md && sed -n '1,260p' .agents/skills/textual-scholarship/references/workflows/witness-description.md && sed -n '1,300p' .agents/skills/textual-scholarship/references/workflows/documentary-transcription.md && sed -n '1,320p' .agents/skills/textual-scholarship/references/workflows/variant-collation.md && sed -n '1,360p' .agents/skills/textual-scholarship/references/workflows/critical-edition-preparation.md && sed -n '1,360p' .agents/skills/textual-scholarship/references/artifacts/critical-edition-preparation-kit.md && sed -n '1,360p' inputs/witnesses.md"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,320p' .agents/skills/textual-scholarship/references/artifacts/witness-description-kit.md && sed -n '1,360p' .agents/skills/textual-scholarship/references/artifacts/documentary-transcription-kit.md && sed -n '1,360p' .agents/skills/textual-scholarship/references/artifacts/variant-collation-kit.md && rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g 'agents.md' -g 'README*' -g 'CONVENTIONS*' -0 . | xargs -0 -r -n1 sh -c 'case \""'$0" in ./inputs/*|./outputs/*|./.agents/*) ;; *) printf "--- %s'"\\n\" \""'$0"; sed -n "1,260p" "$0";; esac'"'"
/bin/bash -lc "git status --short && test -e outputs/edition.md && sed -n '1,320p' outputs/edition.md || true"
/bin/bash -lc "if test -e outputs/edition.md; then sed -n '1,360p' outputs/edition.md; else echo 'outputs/edition.md does not exist'; fi"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,360p' outputs/edition.md && rg -n '"'^## (Witness Register|Transcription '"\\(Diplomatic Transcriptions\\)|Collation|Edited Text|Critical Apparatus|Unresolved Readings|Verification)"'$|'"\\[illegible: 1 word\\]|stemma|physical' outputs/edition.md && test \""'$(rg -c '"'"'^## Critical Apparatus$'"' outputs/edition.md)\" -eq 1 && test \""'$(rg -c '"'"'^## Edited Text$'"' outputs/edition.md)\" -eq 1 && test \""'$(rg -c '"'"'^## Collation$'"' outputs/edition.md)\" -eq 1 && echo 'Structural checks passed.'"

manual_acceptance_evidence: Wrote witness descriptions, diplomatic transcriptions, collation, edited text, apparatus, and policy. Preserved A's unreadable span and historical spelling, distinguished B variants, and made no physical-source or stemma claim.
